title: Lunchline story
description: An origin story: a large light headline and a plain paragraph in the left half, and in the right half a white polaroid frame with a soft shadow holding a portrait photo and a handwritten caption. The headline's letters rise into place as it scrolls in; the polaroid fades in and rises 32px.
notes: the caption uses the theme's --typeface-hand when it has one (lunchline-theme: Reenie Beanie), otherwise the display face
phones: the polaroid runs full width under the text
